ABOUT DREAM ADVISORY

Your home loan journey.
Made simpler.

From your first question to your final disbursement.

Dream Advisory India Private Limited is a professional housing loan consultancy helping individuals and families navigate home financing with clarity and confidence.

We work with leading banks and financial institutions to help you explore suitable loan options, competitive interest rates and convenient repayment structures.

  • Personal guidance from your initial consultation.
  • Clear support with documentation and your loan application.
  • Coordination through loan approval and final disbursement.

OUR PEOPLE

Meet the founders.

OUR JOURNEY & COLLECTIVE ACHIEVEMENTS

Individual experience.
A shared vision.

✦

How Dream Advisory began

Before founding Dream Advisory, each member of our founding team spent years in housing finance, guiding clients through loan applications and working with banking partners to bring cases to a close.

That hands-on experience gave the team a clear view of where clients need the most support, from understanding lender requirements to navigating documentation and follow-ups. The founders came together to put that experience to work through one consultancy.

₹100 crore in disbursements per founder

Before starting Dream Advisory, each founder facilitated ₹100 crore in home loan disbursements, building lender relationships and gaining first-hand experience across the loan process.

What we’re building next

We aim to reach more homebuyers, deepen our relationships with banks and financial institutions, and provide clear, reliable guidance from the first conversation through disbursement.
